scope: Read-only source-equipment/time audit of all30 ORIGINAL corpus PDFs. Prospective PR4handback research only; not productionRecipeEquipment/seed truth. Final selected replacementcorpus belongs to parent integration.
review_method: Exact paths derived solely from source_url basenames in data/curation/pr4/recipe-corpus.json. All30 directions read from reviewedPDFtext; originalPDFsha256 computed. ordering: Unique normalized equipment codes per source in first explicit preparation/cooking/assembly mention order. Same-code multiple vessels recorded in notes, not duplicated silently. Source conventional/convection alternatives use OVEN once.
normalization_note: BAKING_PAN covers source bakingdish/bakingpan aliases; exact dimensions and words retained. Supplies separate; optional preparation equipment separate; serving-only items excluded explicitly.
